src/index.ts.overview: Starts on-chain listeners, gold monitoring, the HTTP API and paper engine with process-level error/shutdown handling.

src/config.ts.overview: Central env-driven configuration: chain definitions (RPCs, explorers, DEX factories), quote tokens, alert thresholds, API settings and Gold RWA parameters.

src/listener.ts.overview: Subscribes to DEX factory pool-creation events and watched-wallet Transfer logs on Base and Ethereum, enriches them with market and safety data, and dispatches new-pool and whale-buy signals.

src/wallets.ts.overview: Loads the smart-money/VC/insider watchlist from data/watchlist.json, skipping invalid addresses, and offers lookups by address and by chain.

src/filter.ts.overview: Token safety and market-data layer: viem clients, DexScreener market lookup, honeypot/tax simulation, explorer verification, LP burn check and deployer profile, combined into a PASS/WARN/REJECT verdict.

src/gold_rwa.ts.overview: Gold RWA monitor comparing PAXG and XAUt DEX prices with a spot gold feed, classifying spreads into alert/major levels and alerting only on level changes persisted in data/gold_state.json.

src/notifier.ts.overview: Defines the WhaleSignal shape and dispatches rendered alerts to stdout, Telegram and a generic webhook, recording every signal in the in-memory store.

src/store.ts.overview: In-memory ring buffer of the last 200 signals plus the latest Gold RWA snapshot, read by the HTTP API; resets on restart.

src/api.ts.overview: Serves authenticated monitor/engine JSON endpoints, the stop-engine action and zero-build deck static assets.

src/logger.ts.overview: Creates the shared pino structured logger whose level comes from LOG_LEVEL.

.env.example.overview: Template of every runtime environment variable: RPC endpoints, explorer keys, Telegram/webhook alert targets, whale and pool thresholds, Gold RWA settings, API host/port/token/CORS and log level.

README.md.overview: Project overview covering features, architecture diagram, Raspberry Pi 4 quick start, systemd auto-start, the HTTP JSON API, configuration, layout, alerts, troubleshooting and limitations.

package.json.overview: npm manifest for an ESM TypeScript app run with tsx, with start/listen/gold/typecheck/build scripts and viem, pino and dotenv dependencies.

tsconfig.json.overview: Strict TypeScript compiler settings targeting ES2022 ESM with bundler resolution, compiling src/ to dist/.

data/watchlist.json.overview: Seed watchlist template with placeholder smart-money, VC and insider-cluster wallets that must be replaced with verified addresses.

deploy/DEPLOY.md.overview: Step-by-step Raspberry Pi 4 deployment guide: prerequisites, clone, install, configure, smoke test, systemd install, operation and updates.

deploy/install-service.sh.overview: Installer script that checks npm and .env, installs dependencies, renders the systemd unit with the current user and path, enables the service and prints an API health check command.

deploy/whale-tracker.service.overview: Hardened systemd unit running `npm start` for the tracker with always-restart, no start limit and an optional .env EnvironmentFile.

docs/RPI4_DEPLOYMENT.md.overview: Raspberry Pi 4 deployment and OpenTerminal integration guide covering setup, verification, API settings, endpoints, CORS, custom wallets, Gold RWA parameters and troubleshooting.

src/engine/ledger.ts.overview: Daily append-only JSONL paper ledger with a record hash chain and bounded API reads.

src/engine/decisions.ts.overview: Optional Jev/TypeSafe adapter converts recent candle context into validated trade intents.

src/engine/indicators.ts.overview: Pure OHLCV projections and technical indicators shared by strategies and historical research.

src/engine/loop.ts.overview: Runs exits before entries, deduplicates fresh closed-bar decisions, applies portfolio risk limits and checkpoints paper state for local and hosted adapters.

src/engine/portfolio.ts.overview: Tracks paper cash, position keys, simulated fills, fees and realized/unrealized PnL; places no live orders.

src/engine/risk.ts.overview: Hard entry-risk vetoes for kill state, daily loss, confidence, position count, exposure and strategy cooldown.

src/engine/state.ts.overview: In-memory snapshot and recent decision state consumed by the engine HTTP API.

src/engine/types.ts.overview: Shared candle, trade-intent, strategy, position, fill, decision and snapshot contracts.

src/strategies/library.ts.overview: Nineteen pure strategy evaluators emit narrow buy/sell intents; risk and execution remain in the engine.

src/engine/backtest.ts.overview: Replays earlier closed bars at the next open with shared stop logic, fees, slippage and deterministic risk limits; accepts verified Binance CSV history.

src/engine/market.ts.overview: Fetches public marks, preferring exchanges with a fresh, contiguous closed window as of request start; preserves an exit mark if no window qualifies.

src/engine/stress.ts.overview: Fee/slippage sensitivity research over strategy replay results.

src/engine/sweep.ts.overview: Parameter-grid research using the offline strategy replay harness.

src/strategies/registry.ts.overview: Loads enabled strategy settings by merging JSON overrides with evaluator defaults.

tests/deck.test.mjs.overview: Behavioral deck regressions for auth cancellation, stale replies, motion budgets, stable depth, startup, agent selection, simulated paths, stop acknowledgement and quote denominations.

api/[...path].js.overview: Allowlisted same-origin Vercel proxy to a configured HTTPS engine origin; forwards browser authorization, rejects redirects, bounds requests and preserves explicit upstream/auth failures.

deck/app.js.overview: Live HUD runtime: versioned polling, keyed feeds, market selection, expandable panels, selectable neural agents and canvas motion governed by visibility, pause and reduced-motion preferences.

deck/index.html.overview: Accessible zero-build deck structure with portfolio, interactive brain, model, tape, cortex and trace panels plus live status controls.

deck/style.css.overview: Neon HUD design system with telemetry/orbit animations, panel/agent interaction states, responsive grids and still-mode fallbacks.

scripts/build-deck.mjs.overview: Copies only public HUD assets into the Vercel output and enables the explicitly labeled read-only demo fallback for hosted pages.

tests/hosting.test.mjs.overview: Checks unset/unreachable engine origins, credential-preserving proxy behavior, explicit auth failures, request restrictions and malformed upstream responses.

src/engine/execution.ts.overview: Shares adverse paper slippage, fee-aware stop-risk sizing, and sampled stop, trailing, target and time exits between the engine and replay.

src/strategies/macd-bb.ts.overview: Adapts Hummingbot MACD and Bollinger signals to long-only spot paper entries with ATR stop distance, trailing activation and bounded duration.

docs/PAPER_STRATEGY.md.overview: Documents upstream provenance, paper execution behavior and reproducible historical comparisons that did not establish a profitable edge.
